description: The second contract against the same site (standards §11 Q4, the M6 extension exercise): a different machine behind a different door, priced by a different sheet, and not one line of sim.
title: Cold Storage again
text: The client came back. There is a second machine behind the door at the back of that server room, and they want what is on it. The door takes a maintenance token, or you can come in at the window on the fire stair and go down. It is a longer sit at the keyboard than last time. Nobody is in a hurry, so the sheet is different: a body costs more than it did and a hole in a wall costs almost nothing.

objectives.description: Leave the site carrying the archive
